sources.entry: Layout Designer for UICollectionView - A simple but powerful tool that helps you make complex layouts for UICollectionView.

summary.one_liner: A Swift library that builds page-view and card-style paging effects on UICollectionView, usable from UIKit via a custom layout or from SwiftUI via a PagingView-style view, with a companion macOS Layout Designer app.
summary.what_it_does: The library provides a custom UICollectionViewLayout that applies transforms to cells, so a collection view can show stacked, scaled, snapshot-based, or other transformed paging effects without subclassing UICollectionView. The README names several example implementations: TransformableView, SnapshotTransformView, ScaleTransformView and StackTransformView on UIKit, and TransformPageView, SnapshotPageView, ScalePageView and StackPageView on SwiftUI. The SwiftUI views are described as powered by UICollectionView. A macOS app called Layout Designer lets you tweak options, see results in real time, and generate code to copy into a project. The README says the macOS app is open source and can also be bought on the App Store. The framework has no external dependencies and can be installed with CocoaPods, Carthage, Swift Package Manager, or by copying the files under the Lib directory.
use_cases: build a carousel or paging view in iOS
add scale or snapshot transitions to UICollectionView pages
make a page-view effect in SwiftUI
generate layout code from a macOS designer tool
how_to_run: Add the CollectionViewPagingLayout pod to your Podfile and run pod install
Or add the Swift package via Xcode: File > Swift Packages > Add Package Dependency
Or manually copy all files under the Lib directory into your project
notable: Custom UICollectionViewLayout applies transforms to cells with no UICollectionView subclassing
Same effects available for both UIKit and SwiftUI
Companion macOS Layout Designer generates code with real-time preview
caveats: You must set the number of visible items, since by default all cells in the frame are loaded and kept in memory
No RTL layout support; the README suggests StackTransformViewOptions.Layout.reverse as a workaround
The Layout Designer macOS app is available on the App Store as a paid purchase, though the source is open
